title: Racing-Inspired Apparel Design
summary: Racing-inspired apparel graphic commissions developed through concept variations, brand integration, and client-led revisions.
facts: Two separate commissioned shirt designs inspired by racing merchandise
Multiple concept options and client-directed revisions
Final digital artwork delivered; physical shirt production not confirmed
mediaNote: First and second images are the final designs.
fullCaseHtml:
For the Allison-Smith Company, I completed two racing-inspired T-shirt graphic commissions in summer 2026:

Commission 01: ASCO 101 Racing Graphic

The first brief called for a NASCAR-inspired front-and-back shirt graphic featuring “ASCO 101,” “Learn. Apply. Lead.,” a No. 43 race car, and ASCOU branding. I presented multiple treatments and mockups. The client selected a red vintage-inspired car, and I delivered the final artwork.

Commission 02: ASCOU Pit Stop

The second assignment allowed a more open-ended pit stop and racetrack direction. I presented three initial concepts for review. The client selected a direction, and after revisions to figures, racing details, and lettering, I delivered the final artwork below.

Design Approach and Delivery

Physical shirt manufacturing has not been confirmed, so this page presents the digital designs rather than claiming a completed merchandise run.
